_about.what: Per-image reference: the plate in the Ozma Records book that IS this picture, cut out of the page scan, plus the printed caption and any Wikimedia scan.

status.confirmed: our decode was put beside the shortlisted book crops and the plate was identified by eye; on most pages the small italic figure number printed beside the plate corroborates it
status.uncertain: a candidate is held but the match is not settled; shown as a lead, never as an answer

_about.crops: docs/reference/crops/<n>.jpg, cut from the page scan at the decided rectangle, tightened to drop bare paper and the printed figure number, long side 900 px
_about.captions: transcribed from the caption block at the foot of the even page of each spread; the book's own spellings, and the italic J the DjVu layer reads as an F put back
_about.credit: credit is the photographer the Ozma book names for the photograph. licence describes the Wikimedia scan only, and is present only where there is one.
